ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white intensity domains occupying the lobe centers, bisected by a dark central peduncle column; black pixel boundaries exist along the entire trailing edge and distal tips with irregular dendritic patterns encroaching on the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an internal vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; peak amplitudes are significantly larger and more jagged on the outer third of the left lobe trailing edge compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer margin transitioning to a concave sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete dark circular pixel clusters: two distinct spots in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe and one in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three horizontal, low-contrast dark linear streaks visible on the interior white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular serration and potential tissue loss on the far left distal tip; large dark focal circular marking on the lower interior right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of four high-intensity white sub-pixel points (consistent with sessile barnacle attachment) on the black trailing edge of the left lobe tip.
